verdict.rationale: Medusa keeps complete OpenAPI 3.0 specs for its Store and Admin REST APIs in its official repository, downloadable as raw YAML, and these specs power its API reference. The probe's 404s only show the spec is not at the guessed docs-site paths; they do not contradict that the spec exists and can be downloaded. Missing for 10: a documented download link or well-known OpenAPI endpoint on the docs site, and independent hands-on corroboration of using the spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Medusa maintains complete machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 specifications for the Store (and Admin) REST APIs in the medusajs/medusa repository; they power the docs.medusajs.com/api reference.
